source_review.definition: 11个不同点精确位于单位S²，最大化凸包体积。文献允许至多11顶点，与本任务最优值一致：所有球面点均为凸包极点，增加不同球面点不会减小体积。
source_review.primary_source: 亲自核对Hardin–Sloane–Smith1994主页3维11点行，公开值2.354634495069；原始33个小数经有理立体投影重建，精确体积约2.3546344950686153。重建见证和原始精确未舍入见证作区分。Mutoh较弱值未当作最高记录。
source_review.open_status: 亲自阅读Hoehner–Ledford arXiv2608.04392v1引言：n=9已解决，n=11及≥13仍开放；n=10另有即将发表工作，故未选n=10。
source_review.independent_verification: 五种保存构造均独立检查精确单位球面、18个三角支撑面，以内部质心为顶点累加精确四面体体积，与正式检查器的规范支撑平面和定向边界积分一致。检查器对共面多边形面的处理另有任务测试。
source_review.controls: 五种程序、破坏样例、声明成绩完整不变性、严格回放、冷导出与程序错误/非有限数/超时全部通过。
source_review.limits: 冻结H是精确重构值的binary64近似，精确目标另以有理数保留。未证明全局最优，浮点Qhull只作搜索反馈。

source_review.definition: Maximize Euclidean volume of the convex hull of n distinct points on the unit sphere S2. Keep11; add13 and15. Exact rational stereographic representation remains feasible and dense.
source_review.primary_source: Sol checked Hardin–Sloane–Smith Maximal Volume Spherical Codes author table at https://neilsloane.com/maxvolumes/index.html. It labels arrangements putatively optimal and gives2.612834152060 for13,2.804379381835 for15. Sol fetched both coordinate files and verified 39/45 decimal entries. Source files and reconstructed witnesses are hashed.
source_review.open_status: Horvath and Langi, https://math.bme.hu/~ghorvath/inscribedpoly_ddim_4.pdf introduction, describe Mutoh results for up to30 vertices as computer-aided search, not general global optimality proof. Their theorems for d+2/d+3 do not cover13/15 in3D. Excluded classical solved sizes, including12. No proof for13/15 was found in checked sources.
source_review.independent_method: Sol ran both human/reference cases. Independent exact centroid-pyramid volume sums over supporting triangular facets agree with the task oriented boundary/plane-canonicalization method. There are22 and26 facets; exact volumes round to the respective 12-place source values. This certifies reconstructed feasible configurations, not the unrounded original optimizer.
source_review.admission: All five programs, strict replay, invalid points, full score-claim invariance, isolated cold export and program-error/nonfinite/timeout controls passed. Existing11-point archives retained.
